description: This file defines a Java Swing UI component named MafCommand, which creates a panel with a labeled spinner to adjust the MAF (Mass Air Flow) sensor input. The spinner changes trigger updates to an ECU stimulator.

classes.name: MafCommand
classes.description: A Swing JPanel subclass representing a control panel component for adjusting MAF sensor values

methods.name: MafCommand
methods.description: Constructor initializing the UI component with a label and a spinner for MAF value adjustment
